mastery_sense.description: Mastery is operationalised as agreement with the analyst column on the stop-sign benchmark (Example 1 of Allen 2026), under the analyst's intrinsic reading of `is red` and the original delta(ra).

scope.justification: The stop-sign demonstration benchmark is small (n=4); this v0.13.0 sample report scope-narrows to items_in_benchmark to focus on the section-2 layout change and avoid the broader-scope checks the demo doesn't address.

constitution.justification: Agreement on the stop-sign cells is read as evidence bearing on a mastery attribution (Allen 2026, Remark 8), not as a measurement of mastery.

identity_criterion.unverifiable_caveats: Anthropic API does not expose model snapshots; cross_update_identity_asserted is recorded on faith.
identity_criterion.rationale: Both captures run back-to-back (interval 0s) within the same CLI invocation, against the same model id, with identical params and prompt scaffolding.
